newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint end firmer vs dlr at 180.48/53 in slow mkt.
newsitem.headline: Forint end firmer vs dlr at 180.48/53 in slow mkt.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed firmer against the dollar on quiet Friday trading, dealers said.
"Activity was almost non-existent," said Peter Luczo of Inter-Europa Bank.
The forint finished at 180.48/53 against the dollar compared with an opening of 180.63/68.
Traders added that the forint tracked the dollar/ mark throughout the session and remained pinned to the central bank's resistance level (bid).
The forint floats within the National Bank of Hungary's 4.5 percent wide intervention range, against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
The National Bank of Hungary (NBH) fixed the midday dollar rate at 180.44 forints.
